import pathlib,subprocess,json,hashlib,base64,datetime
assert subprocess.check_output(['hostname'],text=True).strip()=='haiyue-vps'

folder=pathlib.Path('/opt/cps-novel/shared/artifacts/verified/v065/evidence');folder.mkdir(mode=0o700,exist_ok=True)

subprocess.run(['docker','cp',str(p),'cps-novel-web-1:/tmp/promo-reclaim-53.ts'],check=True)
